PROJECT_REPORT.md — the single graded report
Every report section = Purpose, Template, Example, Our Project
Problem: providers and clients lack a shared view of real availability
Objectives: self-serve booking, no double-booking, bulk availability, email confirmation
In scope: landing+browse, booking flow, auth, availability model, shared dashboard, email+Meet
Out of scope: payments/billing, ratings/reviews, multi-tenant orgs
Future development: SMS reminders, analytics, two-way sync, drag-to-reschedule, audit logging
Requirements Priority Matrix — FR-1..FR-16 with Main? flag and /10 priority
FR-2 — unauthenticated booking prompts sign-in and returns to the booking flow
FR-4 — booking a provider's slot reserves it across all that provider's services
FR-7 — bulk availability generation by weekdays x date range x time ranges
FR-13 — provider connects their own Google account; not bookable until connected
FR-14 — admin configures the maximum booking horizon
FR-16 — self-registration always yields CONSUMER; only an admin grants PROVIDER/ADMIN
NFR-2 — RBAC via Spring Security and BCrypt-hashed passwords
NFR-3 — all secrets in environment variables, never in the repository
NFR-4 — if meeting-link generation fails the booking still completes and logs the failure
NFR-5 — logical CSS properties and server-rendered dir/lang for an RTL build
Main journey: consumer browses, picks a date, expands a provider, books
Secondary journey: provider manages own availability
Secondary journey: admin operates services, users, appointments, availability
